To,
All RPFCs/Disciplinary Authorities,
Sub: - Streamlining the Complaint Investigation Mechanism-regarding.

Madam/Sir,

To streamline the complaint redressal mechanism, | am directed to request you to follow the
methodology as below: -

1. RPFC shall not forward any complaint to ZVDs directly.

I. All Vigilance Complaints must be forwarded to Vigilance Head Office by RPFCs along with
Preliminary inquiry Report, which must include their clear cut recommendations.

Mi. The ZVDs will investigate into those complaints which have been forwarded to them by
Vigilance Head Office and submit their Inquiry Report within a fortnight from the date of the
receipt in the ZVDs.

IV. The ZVDs may after the investigation, recommend a certain course of action but shall not
prepare any draft Charge-Memorandum, unless specifically asked to do so by Vigilance Head
Office.

V. In Composite cases where Disciplinary Authority is RPFC-I, the Investigation Report shall be
forwarded to RPFC concerned by Vigilance Head Quarters.

These instructions shall come into force with immediate effect.

{This issues with the approval of CVO).
Yours faithfully,

\K

(Uma Mandal)
Regional P.F, Commissioner-I(Vig.)
